seoTitle: How to Set Reminders in Asana Easily
metaDescription: Learn how to configure task reminders in Asana in 2026 using due dates, follow-up tasks, automation rules, and custom notification settings.
intro: Asana doesn't have a single dedicated reminder button, but combining due dates, follow-up tasks, and automation rules gives you a reliable alert system. This guide covers setting dates that trigger default notifications, creating manual follow-ups, and configuring rule-based reminders as deadlines approach.

steps.heading: Set due and start dates
steps.body: Add due dates and start dates to your tasks, which trigger Asana's default morning notifications as deadlines approach.

steps.heading: Create a follow-up task
steps.body: Use the more actions menu on a task to generate a dedicated follow-up task as a manual reminder.

steps.heading: Build a deadline reminder rule
steps.body: Open the Customize menu to create an automation rule with a trigger and action that sends a comment alert as a due date approaches.

steps.heading: Sort My Tasks to surface deadlines
steps.body: Use My Tasks sorting layouts so upcoming and overdue items are automatically elevated to the top of your list.

steps.heading: Customize notification channels
steps.body: Adjust your profile settings to control email, browser, and mobile push alerts, then check the Asana Inbox to verify the alerts are coming through.

faq.question: Does Asana send reminders automatically for due dates?
faq.answer: Yes, tasks with due dates trigger default notifications, though you can build more specific rule-based reminders for extra coverage.

faq.question: Can I set a recurring reminder for a task?
faq.answer: Recurring tasks can be set to repeat on a schedule, which effectively creates a recurring reminder each time the task regenerates.

faq.question: How do I stop getting too many notifications?
faq.answer: Adjust your notification preferences in your profile settings to limit alerts to email, browser, or mobile push individually.

faq.question: Can automation rules remind assignees as a deadline gets close?
faq.answer: Yes, you can configure a rule that triggers an automated comment or alert as a task's due date approaches.
